newsitem.title: USA: PNC Bank issues $300 mln in preferred stk.
newsitem.headline: PNC Bank issues $300 mln in preferred stk.

text.p: PNC Bank Corp said on Wednesday it issued $300 million of fixed adjustable rate noncumulative preferred stock series F, and the net proceeds of the sale would be used buy back PNC common stock.
The six million share issue had a par value of $50 and would pay a dividend of 6.05 percent for five years, PNC said.

The dividend would then be reset quarterly 35 basis points above whichever bond had the greatest yield among the three-month U.S. Treasury bill, the 10-year Treasury note or the 30-year Treasury bond, it said.
PNC said proceeds would be used to buy back its issued and outstanding shares in addition to the previously authorized share repurchase program.
The preferred shares, issued through a syndicate led by Merrill Lynch & Co are redeemable beginning September 30, 2001 at par, the bank said.
They are also redeemable in the event of certain amendments to the Internal Revenue Code relating to the dividend received deduction, it said.
